description: T01 deliverable gate: validates the shared cross-model alignment contract is defined, has positive/negative fixtures, and the validator skeleton proves against them. The full generation-time validator itself is a later task's scope.

checks.description: The shared alignment contract reference must exist
checks.remediation: Author the cross-model alignment contract per T01's acceptance criteria

checks.description: All five required fixture scenarios must be present
checks.remediation: Each fixture must demonstrate one required acceptance scenario per T01's Acceptance Criteria and Release Acceptance sections

checks.description: The three-level fixture must include a non-software parent, software child, and a scoped entity-name collision
checks.remediation: Ensure the fixture's child-software-boundary domain-model.md documents the deliberate E-002 collision with root-boundary, per Acceptance Criterion 2

checks.description: The unknown-boundary-type fixture's expected report must show NEEDS_CLARIFICATION, never PASS
checks.remediation: An undeclared boundary_type must never resolve to a silent PASS in either direction (software or non-software)

checks.description: The contract must explicitly state boundary stereotype and boundary_type are independent axes
must_contain: Do not conflate boundary type with participant stereotype
checks.remediation: T01 explicitly requires: do not conflate boundary type with participant stereotype

checks.description: The contract must document that S11 and S33-S38 are preserved, not renumbered
must_contain: No existing skill ID is renumbered
checks.remediation: Confirm new skill IDs (S32, S39, S40) are selected without renumbering S11 or S33-S38, per T01's acceptance criteria

checks.description: The executable test suite should exist and be runnable (soft: actual execution is a manual/CI verification step, not statically checkable by this gate)
checks.remediation: Run: python3 -m unittest test_alignment_contract -v from scripts/ and confirm all tests pass before considering T01 complete
